  - 30% of students are in group A after some time.

$$

$$
\text{Remaining students} = 1000 - 300 = 700
$$

#### 3. Calculate the number of students in group B
$$
\text{Students in group B} = \frac{3}{5} \text{ of } 700 = \frac{3}{5} \times 700 = 420
$$

#### 4. Calculate the number of students in group C
$$
\text{Students in group C} = \text{Remaining students} - \text{Students in group B} = 700 - 420 = 280
$$

---

\boxed{280}
